metadata.question: Between September through November 2021, did Seattle experience at least 40cm of rainfall?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS Daily (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) for Sep 1–Nov 30, 2021 over a 15 km buffer around downtown Seattle. If CHIRPS returns no images or zero valid pixels, fall back to ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR).
2. Masking strategy: Not applicable (precip datasets are already processed; no cloud masking).
3. Logic: If collection size is 0 -> try fallback -> if still 0 => C1. If valid pixel count is 0 after processing -> try fallback -> if still 0 => C2. If computed value is null/NaN => C3. Otherwise compare total precipitation (cm) to 40 cm and output A (Yes) or B (No).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const roi = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.3321, 47.6062]).buffer(15000);
    const start = '2021-09-01';
    const end = '2021-12-01'; // end is exclusive to cover through Nov 30
    const thresholdCm = 40;

    console.log('ROI: Seattle 15km buffer; Period: 2021-09-01 to 2021-11-30');

    // Helper to safely get region stats
    async function getStats(image, band, scaleMeters) {
      const reducers = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true});
      const dict = await image.select(band).reduceRegion({
        reducer: reducers,
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scaleMeters,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
        bestEffort: true
      }).getInfo();
      // dict has keys like 'band_mean' and 'band_count' where 'band' is the band name
      const meanKey = band + '_mean';
      const countKey = band + '_count';
      const mean = dict ? dict[meanKey] : null;
      const count = dict ? dict[countKey] : 0;
      return {mean, count};
    }

    // 2. Primary: CHIRPS Daily (mm/day) -> sum over time (mm total)
    let used = null;
    let totalCm = null;

    const chirpsCol = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(roi);
    const chirpsSize = await chirpsCol.size().getInfo();
    console.log(`CHIRPS images: ${chirpsSize}`);

    if (chirpsSize > 0) {
      const chirpsSum = chirpsCol.select('precipitation').sum(); // mm
      const chirpsStats = await getStats(chirpsSum, 'precipitation', 5000);
      const chirpsCount = chirpsStats.count || 0;
      const chirpsMm = chirpsStats.mean;
      if (chirpsCount > 0 && chirpsMm !== null && isFinite(chirpsMm)) {
        const cm = chirpsMm / 10.0;
        console.log(`CHIRPS valid pixels: ${chirpsCount}`);
        console.log(`CHIRPS mean total: ${chirpsMm.toFixed(1)} mm (${cm.toFixed(2)} cm)`);
        used = 'CHIRPS';
        totalCm = cm;
      } else {
        console.log('CHIRPS valid pixels: 0 -> Trying ERA5-Land');
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback: ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated (m/day sum) -> sum over time (m) -> convert to cm
    if (totalCm === null) {
      const eraCol = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(roi);
      const eraSize = await eraCol.size().getInfo();
      console.log(`ERA5-Land images: ${eraSize}`);
      if (eraSize === 0) {
        console.log('No images in fallback dataset.');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      const eraSumM = eraCol.select('total_precipitation_sum').sum(); // meters
      // Convert to cm
      const eraSumCm = eraSumM.multiply(100); // m -> cm
      const stats = await getStats(eraSumCm, 'total_precipitation_sum', 9000);
      const count = stats.count || 0;
      const cmVal = stats.mean;
      if (!count || count === 0) {
        console.log('ERA5-Land valid pixels: 0');
        console.log('C2');
        return;
      }
      if (cmVal === null || !isFinite(cmVal)) {
        console.log('ERA5-Land calculation invalid.');
        console.log('C3');
        return;
      }
      console.log(`ERA5-Land valid pixels: ${count}`);
      console.log(`ERA5-Land mean total: ${(cmVal * 10).toFixed(1)} mm (${cmVal.toFixed(2)} cm)`);
      used = 'ERA5-Land';
      totalCm = cmVal;
    }

    // 4. Validation & Final Answer
    if (totalCm === null || !isFinite(totalCm)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const answer = totalCm >= thresholdCm ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(`Used dataset: ${used}; Threshold: 40 cm; Result: ${totalCm.toFixed(2)} cm`);
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
